title: fix(spec): a field authoring inlineHelpText keeps its source-language description
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9QNuvjCQwtdSPN9iYuqUz7V)_
Fixes #29286

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`translateObject` 把字段的 `help` 译文只放到它的来源槽位：字段（服务端或打包声明）写了非空 `inlineHelpText` 时只译 `inlineHelpText`，`description` 保持原文；都没写时才译 `description`。另在 `ObjectFieldLike` 上声明 `inlineHelpText`，并让源语言的 CONTROL 测试真正可失败。
- 为什么改：抽取器按 `help ?? inlineHelpText ?? description` 取 `help` 原文；同时写了两段不同文字的字段，Studio 和设计器读 `description` 时显示的是 `inlineHelpText` 的译文，一句话被换成了另一句话。
- 风险与回滚：只影响已翻译的对象读取；只写 `description` 的字段照旧被翻译，租户改过的值照旧保留，作者能写什么不变。仓库里没有发布的对象同时写这两段文字（只有 showcase `lead_score` 写了 `inlineHelpText`，它没有 `description`）。回滚即撤掉本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` 中 `translateField` 的 help 分支与新的 `authorsInlineHelpText`；`i18n-resolver.test.ts` 中两个 `translateObject` help describe；`.changeset/29153-field-help-on-inline-help-text.md` 改的那一句。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/system/i18n-resolver.test.ts`，应看到 383 条全过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`translateObject` (`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`) serves a field's `objects.OBJECT.fields.FIELD.help` translation on ONE slot, the one the i18n extractor seeded the entry from (seat direction A on #29286, no new public name):

- a field whose served def authors a non-empty `inlineHelpText` gets the translation there, under the per-slot divergence rule as before, and keeps its source-language `description`; a field with only `inlineHelpText` gains no `description`;
- `description` takes the translation only when neither the served field nor the packaged field authors a non-empty `inlineHelpText` (an empty string reads as absent, as in the extractor and the console), and still only while it equals the packaged field's `description` (`valueOverridesPackagedBase`, unchanged);
- the packaged leg: a served `inlineHelpText` blanked over a packaged one leaves an entry that still translates the packaged `inlineHelpText`, so `description` stays in its source language. With no packaged base, only the served field is asked.

The rule lives in one new private helper, `authorsInlineHelpText(field)`, asked of the served and the packaged field. The `translateObject` docblock section is rewritten to state it, and the `ObjectFieldLike` docblock no longer states the old both-slots rule.

**S1.** `ObjectFieldLike` declares `inlineHelpText?: string` beside `inlineTitle`. It was reached only through the index signature.

**S2.** The source-locale CONTROL test could not fail: the `en` bundle's `lead_score.help` repeated the authored text, so serving it and leaving the field untouched gave the same answer. The `en` `help` entry is dropped (a comment says why), and the test is renamed to what it pins now: the source locale, with no `help` entry for the field while `zh-CN` has one, serves the authored `inlineHelpText` and never another locale's. Ablation below.

**Pending changeset corrected.** `.changeset/29153-field-help-on-inline-help-text.md` (unreleased, from PR #29217) said the translation is served on `inlineHelpText` "and on `description` as before". This PR makes that false, so its **Now.** bullet is corrected in the same stroke. `check-empty-changeset.mjs` refuses this by design as the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class: please confirm it on the PR; do not restore the old sentence. The new changeset is `.changeset/29286-field-help-description-slot.md` (spec patch).

### Forced test edits (old behaviour pinned)

All in `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.test.ts`:

1. `a field declaring both description and inlineHelpText gets the translation on both…` (fixture `phone`) now asserts `description` stays `Contact number.`; renamed to `…gets the translation on inlineHelpText only, the slot the entry was seeded from`.
2. `keeps a description that diverged…`: the per-field sibling assertion moves from `phone.description` to `phone.inlineHelpText`.
3. `judges an array-shaped field list…`: the same move for `phone`.
4. `serves the showcase lead_score translation on its authored inlineHelpText…`: asserts `lead_score` gains no `description` (was the translation).
5. The S2 CONTROL above (bundle fixture and name).

New tests (fixture `vat_number`, authoring both texts): the zh-CN read keeps `description`; the same with no packaged base; a served `inlineHelpText` blanked over the packaged one keeps `description`.

## Tests

All readings at head `b639a5b4`, on `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, merge base `5a2bdf9c1`.

- **Red first, on the base.** The three new `vat_number` tests plus a `lead_score` gains-no-`description` test, run against the unfixed resolver: `Tests 4 failed | 11 passed` in the `…reaches the slot the console draws first` describe (`expected '个人客户请留空。' to be 'Tax id used on invoices.'`).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/system/i18n-resolver.test.ts`: `Tests 383 passed (383)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` (under os-verify-lock, `VERDICT command-exit 0`): `Test Files 791 passed (791)`, `Tests 23394 passed | 1 todo`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: `VERDICT command-exit 0` (test layer: 52 files / 240 errors held in `test-typecheck-debt.json`, unchanged).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: `All 14 generated artifacts are up to date`. Nothing to regenerate: no schema, `.describe()` or export changed.
- Consumer `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test` (the served object reads, `meta-item-read-gate.ts` / `form-routes.ts`, run `translateObject`): `Test Files 368 passed (368)`, `Tests 6982 passed | 332 skipped`.

<details><summary>Ablations (one-shot, through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob)</summary>

Spec tests import the resolver from `src/`, so no dist leg applies.

1. **S2 CONTROL can fail now, and could not before.** Mutation: `if (translatedHelp) {` becomes `if (true as boolean) {` (the no-entry guard dropped; anchor 1 to 0, blob `848830f5` to `5ad5b046`).
   - New CONTROL: `× CONTROL: the source locale, which carries no help entry…` (`Tests 1 failed`).
   - The base's CONTROL (`git show 5a2bdf9c:…/i18n-resolver.test.ts` as a temporary copy, deleted after), same mutation: `Tests 1 passed`. Its `en` entry repeated the authored text, so the mutation was invisible to it.
   - Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
2. **The packaged leg is pinned.** Mutation: `!authorsInlineHelpText(packagedField) &&` becomes `true &&`. Result: `× a served inlineHelpText blanked over a packaged one still keeps description in its source language` (`1 failed | 12 passed`). Restored: blob == HEAD.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Equal texts: a field whose `inlineHelpText` and `description` are the same string now keeps its source-language `description`, although the entry translates that same text. The seat's rule is applied as written; whether to also translate `description` when it equals the seeded text is in the report's open questions.
- Option B (a description-specific bundle key) is a new contract key and is not this PR.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gate families: 79 derived, 79 run, 78 exit 0, 1 designed red</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `b639a5b4` (4 paths vs merge base `5a2bdf9c1`), each command run with stdin closed, then `--ran`:

`✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 79 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 79 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 79 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3).`

The one non-zero exit is `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main :: exit 1`, the DELIBERATE CORRECTION refusal for `.changeset/29153-field-help-on-inline-help-text.md` described above. It is red by design; do not restore the old sentence.

</details>
